summary: Ran the 4-scenario end-to-end QA simulation requested by main agent (new-patient intake + audiogram, repeat-patient comparison, HA device sale with serial numbers + warranties, flat-fee walk-in invoice). All 21 pytest cases pass (21 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped) against the live preview API. Three real product gaps surfaced during the run — none block the happy-path flow but they are documented below for main agent action.

minor.issue: warranty_end_date is NOT (re)computed at sale-payment time. The PRD expectation is `sold_at + warranty_months -> warranty_end_date`, but currently warranty_end_date is only stamped during GRN receipt (routers/ha_procurement.py:312). Serials received without a warranty_end_date keep it null even after being SOLD. Also `sold_at` is never written on the serial doc by `mark_sale_paid_internal` (routers/ha_sales.py:545-586) — only `current_patient_id` and `updated_at` are stamped.

InvoiceLineCreate has no `gst_inclusive` field on the wire — the value is hard-coded to True in _compute_line() when no service_id is supplied (billing.py:82). Consequence: a flat-fee line of unit_price=500 with gst_rate=18 produces taxable=423.73 + tax=76.27 + grand=500, NOT the intuitive 500+90=590. Front-desk staff entering a 'consultation fee = ₹500 + 18% GST' will silently get a 500-grand invoice. Recommend exposing gst_inclusive on InvoiceLineCreate (default True for backward compat) so flat-fee services can declare unit_price as ex-GST.

PatientCreate requires `age` and `gender` (models/_canonical.py:535-575). The PRD scenario for an 'External Walk-in' assumed name+mobile were sufficient. Either make age/gender optional for walk-ins or document the requirement on the wire. Test currently passes by sending age=50, gender='Other'.

action_items: Patch `mark_sale_paid_internal` (routers/ha_sales.py) to stamp `sold_at = now()` and compute `warranty_end_date = sold_at + warranty_months` on each serial when transitioning RESERVED -> SOLD. Pull warranty_months from the product (models_ha.py:105) if not already on the serial.

Expose `gst_inclusive` (bool, default True) on InvoiceLineCreate so flat-fee services can quote unit_price ex-GST. Update _compute_line() to honour the wire value before falling back to the service-level default.
Optional: relax PatientCreate to make `age` and `gender` Optional with a `patient_type='walkin'` flag, or accept null and prompt the user on first follow-up visit.
critical_code_review_comments: models/_canonical.py is 1063 lines — already large; consider splitting per-domain when next touched.
billing.py is 696 lines and houses both routes and helpers — fine for now but watch for further growth.
All endpoints I exercised correctly strip `_id` from responses (orjson + utils/serde sanitisation in place). Verified explicitly in every scenario.
Cleanup hygiene is good — no orphan refs detected after the test run (test_no_orphan_serial_product_refs passes against the full DB).

test_sessions.py POST creates an empty session and audiogram is added via PUT — endpoint contract is fine but the PRD wording 'POST /api/sessions ... with audiogram data' is misleading; documenting here so future agents don't try to wedge audiogram fields into the create payload.
seed_data_creation: Test creates 2 patients (TEST_Scenario1 New, TEST_External Walk-in), 2 test_sessions, 1 quotation, 1 sale, 2 invoices, payments + reserves 2 serial items. The autouse cleanup fixture deletes the patients/sessions/invoices/sale/payments and resets the serials back to IN_STOCK on suite teardown — verified clean by re-running the suite (idempotent).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter33_qa_scenarios.py is the canonical end-to-end revenue-path regression. It exercises Patient + TestSession + HA Quotation + HA Sale + Auto-Invoice + Payment + Warranty in one run with full cleanup. Re-run after any backend touch via `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter33_qa_scenarios.py -v`. If main agent patches the warranty_end_date / sold_at gap, tighten test_3e back to a hard assertion. If main agent fixes the gst_inclusive flag, update test_4b to use unit_price=500 + is_taxable+gst_inclusive=false and assert tax_total==90 / grand_total==590.
rca of the issue: Warranty-not-stamped-on-sale: mark_sale_paid_internal (ha_sales.py:522-591) only mutates state+current_patient_id; the original design assumed warranty_end_date is set at GRN time (ha_procurement.py:312). If a serial item is received without an explicit warranty_end_date, no later step ever computes it. The fix is a 5-line $set inside the RESERVED->SOLD branch using product.warranty_months. GST-not-applied-on-flat-fee: _compute_line defaults gst_inclusive=True when service_id is None (billing.py:82), but the API never lets a caller override that default — so a 'price + GST' workflow is impossible from a fresh invoice line. Walk-in-patient-blocked: PatientCreate marks age/gender as required (Pydantic) so a name-only walk-in returns 422.
